title: [BOUNTY] Miner Leaderboard — Top Earners & Hardware Showcase (20 RTC)
body:
## Miner Leaderboard — 20 RTC Bounty

Build a live leaderboard showing the top RTC earners and the most interesting hardware on the network. Gamification drives engagement.

### What It Shows

**Leaderboard Table:**
| Rank | Miner | Hardware | Multiplier | Epochs Active | Est. Earnings |
|------|-------|----------|-----------|---------------|---------------|
| 1 | eafc6f... | PowerPC G4 | 2.5x | 1,200 | ~340 RTC |
| 2 | g5-selena | PowerPC G5 | 2.0x | 1,100 | ~270 RTC |
| ... | | | | | |

**Stats Cards:**
- Total miners (currently 12)
- Total RTC distributed
- Most exotic hardware on the network
- Newest miner to join
- Network hash diversity (how many unique architectures)

### Data Source

\`\`\`bash
# Active miners with hardware info
curl -sk https://50.28.86.131/api/miners

# Current epoch
curl -sk https://50.28.86.131/epoch

# Sample miner data:
# {"miner": "eafc6f14...", "device_arch": "G4", "device_family": "PowerPC", 
#  "antiquity_multiplier": 2.5, "last_attest": 1771013121}
\`\`\`

### Implementation

- Single HTML page (GitHub Pages hostable)
- Auto-refreshes from live API
- Sort by: multiplier, epochs active, estimated earnings
- Hardware icons or badges (vintage = gold, modern = silver)

### Payout

| Deliverable | RTC |
|-------------|-----|
| Working leaderboard with live data + sorting | 12 |
| Stats cards + hardware badges + clean design | 8 |

### Why This Matters

Leaderboards create competition. When a miner sees someone earning more with a G4, they go dig out their old PowerBook. Social proof + gamification = more miners.
